promises.quote: the Trust has committed to undertaking a formal and comprehensive review of our 'Smoke Free' policy which has commenced and is due to be concluded in July 2023, which will also include how we ensure that practice reflects policy, particularly around leave.
promises.summary: Review Smoke Free policy to align practice with policy, especially regarding leave

reports.title: Michael Hindes: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: we will take the opportunity to raise awareness within the Trust via a specific newsletter article issued to Trust staff (known as our Monthly Learning Bulletin) to remind and promote how and when to best ensure there are meaningful conversations with patients around sharing information with families. This will focus on the Triangle of Care approach and provide clarity around the delicate balance between encouraging patients whilst respecting their wishes and ensuring this is clearly documented.
promises.summary: Issue monthly learning bulletin on family engagement

promises.quote: At national level, as part of our mission to build an NHS fit for the future, we will make sure mental health care is delivered in the community wherever possible - through new models of care and support available for those who are struggling - so that more people are prevented from needing to go into hospital.
promises.summary: Expand community mental health care to reduce hospital admissions

promises.quote: The Trust (SWLStG) fully acknowledges the concern regarding insufficient bed capacity in London and the reason why the Coroner has cause to raise these concerns.
promises.summary: Acknowledge concern and commit to improving bed capacity
